name: Lumber and plywood
summary: Boards, beams, plywood and pallets for building, repairs and fuel.
uses: Framing shelters, sheds and raised beds
Clean untreated offcuts for cooking fires
identify: Lumber yards, hardware stores, building sites, pallets behind every warehouse and shop, fences, decks and furniture. Treated lumber is often green or brown-tinged with a stamped tag. Pallets stamped HT are heat-treated; MB means chemically fumigated.
test: Push a knife point in: sound wood resists, rotten wood is soft and crumbly. Sight along boards for warping. Never burn treated wood or MB pallets: the smoke is toxic.

decay.note: Lasts if dry. Wood left wet rots in a few years, faster in heat.
